name: chronicle
description: Records every Claude Code session's toil into an account-scoped SQLite chronicle — per-turn token usage (input, cache read/creation, output, thinking), context growth, prompts, tool calls, subagents, compactions, duration and API-equivalent cost — read from the transcripts on disk, pull only, no hooks. The overseer dashboard grows a Chronicle page when it is present and keeps the chronicle synced while it shows.
